title: mcpwarp envelope ops
description: Strict, test-time-only conformance oracle for the 8 mcpwarp envelope ops defined in docs/MCPWARP.md §2. An instance is the value of `body.mcpwarp` inside a ws-mixer `app` control message (WIRE.md §2.7), not the `app` message itself. Never linked into production SDK code. additionalProperties:false is stricter than the receiver: the §2 decode rules ignore unknown fields, default absent or null lists to [], decode `created: null` as false, and pass unknown register/app error codes through, so this schema rejects what a decoder tolerates in order to catch typos. `enum`, `minItems` and `maxItems` are stated here for readers and real validators; spec/tools/check-fixtures.mjs enforces them in code because its validator subset ignores them.

register.title: register
register.description: Agent -> edge, sent after every welcome (and after enable). The SDK sends exactly one service per message. MCPWARP.md §2, §3.

name.description: SERVICE_NAME_RE, at most SERVICE_NAME_MAX (30) characters; a name the edge rejects comes back as registered.errors[] INVALID_NAME

unregister.title: unregister
unregister.description: Agent -> edge, sent by close() only when a register went out on the live connection. MCPWARP.md §2, §3.

registered.title: registered
registered.description: Edge -> agent, reply to register. Decode rules (MCPWARP.md §2): absent or null `services`/`errors` -> []; `url` is required and non-empty (an absent or empty url is MALFORMED_ENVELOPE); `created` absent or null -> false; null in an optional string -> MALFORMED_ENVELOPE.

url.description: public URL of the service; becomes handle.url, never ""

created.description: true only when this register created the service

name.description: echoes the requested name, so it is not held to SERVICE_NAME_RE (INVALID_NAME echoes an invalid one)

code.description: RegisterErrorCode; a decoder passes an unknown code through (treated like BAD_REQUEST)

unregistered.title: unregistered
unregistered.description: Edge -> agent, reply to unregister. Absent or null `services` -> []; `services[].id` defaults to "". MCPWARP.md §2.

disable.title: disable
disable.description: Edge -> agent, unsolicited: the service was disabled in the dashboard. MCPWARP.md §2, §3.

enable.title: enable
enable.description: Edge -> agent, unsolicited: the service was re-enabled; the agent registers again. Matched by name. MCPWARP.md §2, §3.

conflict.title: conflict
conflict.description: Edge -> agent (the old holder), unsolicited: another connection registered the same (token subject, name). Matched by name or server id; sticky; the old holder never re-registers. MCPWARP.md §3.

error.title: error
error.description: Edge -> agent, an app-level error about the last op. UNSUPPORTED_VERSION is fatal; OVERLOADED re-sends the outstanding op after 1000 ms; the rest are non-fatal. MCPWARP.md §2.

code.description: AppErrorCode; a decoder passes an unknown code through as a non-fatal error
